title: LibGodot: Add global class API dump support
body:
This PR adds support for dumping API information for global and autoload classes that could be implemented by scripts or GDExtensions.

It depends on the following PR, which extends the MethodInfo of ClassDB with some missing information that is required for dynamically (at runtime) generated GDExtension bindings:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/124007

Developed by [Migeran](https://migeran.com)

## References

This is the next part of the LibGodot feature.
Original feature: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/90510

Merged PRs:
